caption: The drawing features a rectangular section filled with a vivid scene composed primarily of a bird and floral elements. At the center of the composition, slightly to the left, is a red bird perched on a branch; its wings and body are oriented diagonally from the lower left to the upper right. Surrounding the bird are large, densely packed flowers and leaves in shades of red, pink, yellow, and cream, with some flowers featuring blue centers or blue petals. The stems and leaves are green with some tan highlights. The background of the entire scene is a deep, textured blue. The largest flower, located toward the bottom center, is notably red with a pale yellow center and outlined petals. Small red flower buds and green leaves fill in the spaces between the larger flowers. The entire drawing is bordered by a plain, wide expanse of light beige paper, which frames the colorful, intricate central artwork.
title: Crewel Embroidered Panel
